items.titleZh: 互联网相信 Elon Musk 的 xAI 操纵了 OpenAI 的“Dots”发布
items.titleEn: The internet is convinced Elon Musk’s xAI trolled OpenAI’s ‘Dots’ launch
items.summaryZh: TechCrunch AI 报道了人工智能领域的产品开发。消息来源要点：周二，在 OpenAI 推出新的人工智能代理 Dots 之前，埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 xAI 已经获得了域名“dot.com”，该域名现在重定向到 Grok 聊天机器人下载页面。
items.summaryEn: TechCrunch AI reports a product development in AI. Key point from the source: Before OpenAI launched its new AI agent, Dots, on Tuesday, Elon Musk's xAI had already acquired the domain name "dot.com," which now redirects to the Grok chatbot download page.

items.overviewEn: TechCrunch AI published a new update about “The internet is convinced Elon Musk’s xAI trolled OpenAI’s ‘Dots’ launch”.
